en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Spindle Bearings</p:
Spindle Bearings

Spindle Bearings

These are bearings dedicated to machine tool spindles, mainly using contact angles of 15° and 25°. Open Type and Sealed Type versions are available, along with an ultra-high-speed series with smaller balls (HS, HSS), a series using ceramic balls (HC, HCS), and a series using Cronidur steel (XC, XCS).

Supplied in three types: the standard-width 70 series, the wide, high-load 72 series, and the ultra-thin 719 series.

The dimension table below is based on the permissible rotational speed (rpm) under oil lubrication for 15° contact angle, P4S-grade, universally matchable (UL) bearings.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.

en.<strong>조합(배열) 방식 — UL/DB/DF/DT</strong>:
Combination (Arrangement) Method — UL/DB/DF/DT · Precision Grade — P5/P4/P2
The table below lists only UL (universally matchable) single units; customers mount two or more together — DB (back-to-back, O-arrangement, strong against overturning moment) · DF (face-to-face, X-arrangement, favorable for shaft deflection) · DT (tandem, distributes load in one direction). There is no separate model number after combining, and you can switch the UL/DB/DT notation in the dimension table using the arrangement toggle.
Precision grades run from P5 (ABEC 5, for general machine tools) to P4 (ABEC 7, for high-speed, high-precision CNC — our table is based on the finer P4S sub-grade) to P2 (ABEC 9, for ultra-precision applications such as grinders); the smaller the grade number (P-grade), the higher the precision.
Our in-stock dimension table is based on preload grade L (light preload) and UL arrangement. For 3- or 4-bearing combinations, other preload/precision grades, and exact tolerance/runout allowances, please check with us before ordering.
